claim.purpose: Resolve #5247 Runtime v3 state-authenticity and readiness findings

initial.title: [v0.91.7][review-fix][runtime-v3][security] Resolve #5247 state authenticity and readiness findings
initial.goal: Close every #5247 Runtime v3 authenticity, soak-readiness, and source-budget finding with executable proof.
initial.required_outcome: Memory restore and private projection fail closed without authentic accepted-lineage evidence; the real soak has a declared bounded lane; and the 10K source target has a reviewed disposition.
authority_boundary: Runtime v3 owns runtime state; C-SDLC v2 owns lifecycle records
initial.task_boundary: Repair the four #5247 findings without changing Runtime v3 cutover defaults or absorbing Observatory/live-parity work from #5413.
deliverables: Scheduled/release soak runner and retained contract
acceptance_criteria: Full checkpoint contents identity sequence head and lineage are authenticated
Private projection requires a verified record accepted into the exact lineage
A bounded release or scheduled lane executes the real 100-cycle soak
Source LoC is below 10K or a reviewed exception and reduction plan is retained
non_goals: Reconstructing historical six-card bundles owned by #5406
initial.plan_summary: Authenticate both state paths first, add focused forgery/lineage tests, route the real soak through a bounded release lane, then close the LoC finding with a reproducible disposition.

steps.action: Implement signed checkpoint canonicalization and verification
Require verified accepted-lineage membership for private projection
Add and prove the bounded real-soak release lane
Recount source and retain reviewed LoC disposition/reduction plan

invariants: No unauthenticated state enters restore or projection
Lineage membership is proven by the owning lineage object
risks: Checkpoint schema evolution can break retained fixtures
Projection API changes can require caller migration
The real soak may expose latent timing failures
LoC reduction can tempt unrelated refactoring
stop_conditions: Lineage membership cannot be proven without widening authority
Soak lane would become a mandatory ordinary-PR cost
LoC work requires unrelated product redesign

validation_lanes.proof_role: Focused checkpoint and private-state positive/negative proof
Reproducible source count and reviewed disposition

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on signature, identity, sequence, head, lineage, soak, or budget uncertainty; preserve opt-in cutover truth.
review_prompts: Can any checkpoint field be altered without signature failure?
Can a validly signed but unaccepted or wrong-lineage record be projected?
Does the scheduled lane execute the real ignored soak rather than a retained packet assertion?
Is the LoC disposition reproducible, owned, and bounded?
